Here’s a **clear, practical master list** you can use to build a chore chart for everyone in the house. I’ve broken it down by **zones** and **task type**, so it’s easy to assign by person, age, or frequency.

---

## 🏠 Whole House (Shared Responsibilities)
**Daily**
- Make beds  
- Pick up clutter (floors, counters, tables)  
- Put items back where they belong  
- Dishes into dishwasher or washed  
- Trash taken out if full  

**Weekly**
- Vacuum and mop floors  
- Dust surfaces (shelves, baseboards, fans)  
- Wipe doors, light switches, handles  
- Clean mirrors and glass  
- Empty all trash cans  

---

## 🍽 Kitchen
**Daily**
- Load and unload dishwasher  
- Wash dishes and wipe sink  
- Wipe counters and stove top  
- Sweep floor  
- Put food away  

**Weekly**
- Mop kitchen floor  
- Clean microwave inside and out  
- Clean fridge shelves as needed  
- Wipe cabinet fronts and handles  
- Take out recycling  

**Monthly**
- Deep clean fridge  
- Clean oven  
- Organize pantry  
- Check and toss expired food  

---

## 🚽 Bathrooms
**Daily**
- Wipe sink and counter  
- Hang towels properly  
- Pick up floor  

**Weekly**
- Clean toilet (inside and out)  
- Scrub shower or tub  
- Clean mirror  
- Replace towels  
- Mop floor  

**Monthly**
- Deep clean grout  
- Organize under sink  
- Replace empty products  

---

## 🛋 Living Room / Family Room
**Daily**
- Straighten pillows and blankets  
- Pick up clutter  
- Wipe coffee table  

**Weekly**
- Dust furniture and electronics  
- Vacuum rugs and furniture  
- Clean windows or glass doors  

**Monthly**
- Organize drawers or baskets  
- Clean behind furniture  

---

## 🛏 Bedrooms
**Daily**
- Make bed  
- Put clothes away  
- Keep floor clear  

**Weekly**
- Change sheets  
- Dust surfaces  
- Vacuum or sweep  

**Monthly**
- Organize closet  
- Go through laundry piles  
- Declutter nightstands and drawers  

---

## 🧺 Laundry Area
**Daily or As Needed**
- Sort laundry  
- Start and switch loads  
- Fold and put away clothes  

**Weekly**
- Clean lint trap  
- Wipe washer and dryer  

**Monthly**
- Clean washer filter  
- Organize laundry supplies  

---

## 🚪 Entryway / Hallways
**Daily**
- Shoes put away  
- Bags and coats hung up  

**Weekly**
- Sweep or vacuum  
- Wipe door handles and rails  

**Monthly**
- Organize shoes and coats  

---

## 🌳 Outdoor / Garage (if applicable)
**Weekly**
- Take out trash bins  
- Sweep porch or garage  

**Monthly**
- Organize tools or storage  
- Check and tidy yard  

---

## 🔁 Optional Chore Chart Categories
You may want to label chores as:
- **Daily**
- **Weekly**
- **Monthly**
- **Rotating**
- **Shared**
- **Personal Responsibility**

# 🗓 Weekly Rotating Chore Schedule (3 People)

## CORE DAILY TASKS (Everyone, Every Day)
Each person:
- Make bed  
- Pick up personal clutter  
- Put dishes in dishwasher or wash them  
- Wipe personal bathroom or bedroom surfaces if used  

---

## WEEKLY ROTATION

### 🔁 WEEK 1
**Person A**
- Kitchen (daily wipe downs + weekly deep clean)  
- Take out trash and recycling  

**Person B**
- Bathrooms (all bathrooms weekly clean)  
- Restock paper products  

**Person C**
- Living room and common areas  
- Vacuum and mop whole house  

---

### 🔁 WEEK 2
**Person A**
- Bathrooms  
- Restock paper products  

**Person B**
- Living room and common areas  
- Vacuum and mop whole house  

**Person C**
- Kitchen  
- Trash and recycling  

---

### 🔁 WEEK 3
**Person A**
- Living room and common areas  
- Vacuum and mop whole house  

**Person B**
- Kitchen  
- Trash and recycling  

**Person C**
- Bathrooms  
- Restock paper products  

---

🔄 **Repeat the cycle every 3 weeks**

---

## 🧺 LAUNDRY ROTATION (Optional Add-On)
Rotate weekly or assign permanently.

**Option 1: Weekly Rotation**
- Week 1: Person A  
- Week 2: Person B  
- Week 3: Person C  

**Option 2: Everyone does their own laundry**

---

## 🌿 MONTHLY DEEP CLEAN (Rotate Monthly)
Pick one weekend per month.

**Month 1**
- Person A: Fridge and pantry  
- Person B: Oven and microwave  
- Person C: Closets and storage  

**Month 2**
- Rotate again

---

## ✅ HOW TO USE THIS
- Post **Week 1–3** on the fridge  
- Change the week every Monday  
- Use checkboxes for accountability  
- Keep tasks under **30–45 minutes per person**
